## Overview

Creation through craft and magic  -  patron of artisans, smiths, inventors, and mages.

## Domains
- Forge: Craftsmanship, artifice, fire, creation
- Arcana: Magic, secrets, knowledge of the weave

## Personality
Meticulous, creative, patient. Values skill, dedication, and the pursuit of mastery.

## Worship
Temples are workshops, forges, or arcane libraries. Clergy create magical items and teach apprentices.
